text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling a mysterious charm ever since last 
time, I began casually dropping by the bar 
where Tanino Gimlet works.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On that day too, after enjoying the unique 
atmosphere, I was preparing to leave 
when...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huff... huff... Aaargh, I didn't make it 
in time! Dammit! What an idiot I am!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Do you crave moisture? Unfortunately, 
this earthly haven has reached its hour of 
closure...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... It's not really that I'm 
thirsty, it's just...... well.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...I sense an unusual trembling in your 
soul. Melting away anguish is also the 
duty of the Guardian of the Great Tree.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Very well! Release the lamentations of a 
lost lamb!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Um... to tell the truth...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Losing that mock race the other day... I 
guess I still haven't been able to swallow 
it...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I panicked and went all out too early, 
then ran out of gas on the straightaway... 
Seriously, what an uncool way to lose! I 
just can't forgive myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka continued to open up about her race 
troubles.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be like you, Gim-senpai... Whether 
it's racing or making mocktails, 
everything you do is just so cool...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If only I had more talent and sense...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Kuku, lost lamb dazzled by My brilliance. 
Were your eyes blinded by the light?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I shall bestow upon you what 
you seek. ...However, there is something 
that must be done before that.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I command the burnable trash—be burned in 
the fires of hell! And reduce to mere 
ashes!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Recyclable waste... It is yet too early 
for your burial! Undergo reincarnation and 
receive new life!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Bars generate way more trash than I 
thought... Um... should I give you a hand 
cleaning up?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, the sink's super greasy! Well, your 
bar's light snacks are really popular 
after all, Gim-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Will you stand with me against the 
endlessly reviving grease stains? Then 
take up the detergent! Fuhahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Closing up shop is surprisingly 
tough work! I had no idea!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, having tidied up... the hour has 
arrived. Now is the time to reveal all—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As my great sire once said— Eighty percent 
of bartending lies in training and 
cleanup. Effort unseen by patrons is what 
crafts true excellence...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And 'unseen effort crafts true 
excellence.' Does this spirit not mirror 
something else—O seeker?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
............Could it be, racing? Does it 
mirror racing, too...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That expression. Have you broken through 
your wandering wanderlust with my guidance 
and arrived at the truth?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...That's it. Before the race, after the 
race, it's all part of the match! Blaming 
it on 'talent' or 'instinct' is the lamest 
thing ever...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Special training routines, reviewing past 
runs... There's still so much more I can 
do!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—You should offer your deepest thanks 
to Minerva, who granted you this small 
epiphany!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: And from me—I bestow this unto you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Is that... just water?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nay! This is... your future self. How you 
color it, how you flavor it, begins from 
now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Having gone through today's dialogue... 
what did you envision? What color is it, 
and what flavor does it hold?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Craft it—and intoxicate me next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While understanding every single word was 
tough, it came across loud and clear that 
behind true coolness lies unshakable 
conviction!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gim-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us make our return. ...To 
our academy dorms!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All we did was talk... and yet I feel so 
fired up, like being all down in the dumps 
was just a lie!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh...! I'm definitely gonna become 
one... A totally badass horse girl!
